lines.text: TO WRITE (story lane): 30 own street lines, about 7 words each, in the voice of the card (people/simon_ombler.json). Situations from line-situations.json (greetings by rung and by regard, everyday remarks, the knowing ladder, farewells); at least three closing lines. Everyday remarks of his own are owed even where situational lines exist. Names him: the new owner (rung 1), Mr Nowak or Nowak (2), Frank (3), Frank or Mr Nowak (4, the port's man); Sheila withholds his name until she trusts him; Ron says boss; only the Widow, Danny and Ron once say Frankie; nobody says Tom.
